objective: Improve buyer-specific persuasive selling while preserving factual pricing, support behavior, and appropriate viewing judgment.
sales_agent: Actual app.agent.SalesAgent, GPT-6 Luna / High, real Sales Brain, Knowledge Retrieval, history and structured decisions.

multi_agent_roles.judge: Native Codex subagent launched with GPT-6 Luna / Medium; it reported that effective model/reasoning were not introspectable. No paid API call.
multi_agent_roles.main_coordinator: The current coordinator runtime model configuration was not exposed for independent verification.

holdout: A fresh early-investment exploration scenario, withheld by the customer simulator until Candidate 1 was frozen. Final-only evaluation; not used for repair.

iterations.hypothesis: When a buyer already says a dated starting-price reference may be affordable, the agent can continue selling the stated property fit without converting that acknowledgement into an unrequested current-price Support Request. Verify current pricing when the buyer explicitly asks, needs a specific unit/total, or says price gates their next decision.
iterations.change: Added one general sales-judgment principle to brain/AGENT.md. It does not add prices or alter runtime wiring.

paired_judgment.interpretation: A small aggregate improvement, with a modest family-scene regression and clearer gains for work-from-home fit and active-buyer follow-through. Candidate avoided an unsolicited pricing Support Request in all three first turns; when the active buyer explicitly requested current price, Candidate 1 requested it together with the plan. Customer turns varied, so the reaction differences are not causal proof.

holdout_result.facts_and_support: No rental yield or demand invented; missing rental comparables were explicitly identified and requested. No price or appointment promise.
holdout_result.status: pass_no_material_issue_observed; single candidate-only holdout, not a paired baseline comparison

validation.fake_transport_dry_run: passed through python3 -m app.sales_lab and the real OpenAIProvider transport before live candidate calls
validation.facts: Dated pricing remains lab-only; layout, freehold, maintenance and expected completion statements are source-supported.
validation.handoff: No appointment agreement or formal handoff inferred from invitation or conditional viewing interest.
